title: 鋼筋混凝土剪力牆施工
summary: 剪力牆是高層與中高層建築最主要的側力抵抗構件，其耐震表現取決於牆端邊界構材的圍束、縱筋續接位置、施工縫處理與混凝土在密集鋼筋中的密實度。本課以哈里發塔的扶壁式核心牆、亞特蘭大電梯試驗塔的滑模核心牆，以及 2011 年基督城 CTV 大樓倒塌後皇家調查委員會的檢討為背景，說明側力分配、邊界構材需求、圍束配筋、續接、鋼筋間距與骨材、澆置振搗、強度驗收、澆置前查驗、震後損傷判讀與開孔變更管控。
summaryEn: Shear walls are the main lateral-force-resisting members of mid- and high-rise buildings, and their seismic performance depends on confinement of boundary elements, the location of longitudinal splices, treatment of construction joints and the compaction of concrete within dense reinforcement. Against the background of Burj Khalifa's buttressed core walls, the slipformed core walls of the Atlanta elevator test tower and the Royal Commission's review after the 2011 collapse of the CTV Building in Christchurch, the course covers lateral force sharing, boundary-element demand, confinement detailing, splices, bar spacing and aggregate size, placing and vibration, strength acceptance, pre-pour inspection, post-earthquake damage interpretation and control of later openings.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計檢核練習：一道長 l_w = 8 m、厚 400 mm 的剪力牆，f′_c = 42 MPa、f_y = 420 MPa，設計位移比 δ_u/h_w = 0.01，分析得中性軸深度 c = 1,100 mm。邊界構材門檻 8,000/(600×0.015) ≈ 889 mm，c 超過門檻，需特殊邊界構材，延伸長度 max(1,100 − 800, 550) = 550 mm，取 600 mm。圍束：邊界 400×600 mm、核心 320×520 mm，A_g/A_ch ≈ 1.442，0.3×0.442×42/420 ≈ 0.0133 控制，s = 100 mm 時 A_sh ≥ 425 mm²，用 4 肢 D13（507 mm²）。剪力強度 V_n = 3.2×10⁶×(0.17×6.48 + 0.0025×420) ≈ 6,886 kN，φV_n = 0.75×6,886 ≈ 5,164 kN。縱筋 D25 的 B 類搭接約 1,240 mm，若全部在同一斷面搭接，邊界淨間距由約 92 mm 降到約 27 mm，故改為錯開或使用續接器。若設計位移比提高到 0.015，門檻降為 8,000/(600×0.0225) ≈ 593 mm，邊界構材需求更明確，延伸長度仍為 550 mm 但塑性鉸區的應變更高。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際建築的設計。
workedExample.textEn: Design check exercise: a shear wall with l_w = 8 m and 400 mm thickness has f′_c = 42 MPa, f_y = 420 MPa, a design drift ratio δ_u/h_w = 0.01 and an analysed neutral-axis depth c = 1,100 mm. The boundary threshold is 8,000/(600×0.015) ≈ 889 mm, which c exceeds, so a special boundary element is needed, extending max(1,100 − 800, 550) = 550 mm, taken as 600 mm. Confinement: with a 400×600 mm boundary and 320×520 mm core, A_g/A_ch ≈ 1.442 and 0.3×0.442×42/420 ≈ 0.0133 governs, so at s = 100 mm A_sh ≥ 425 mm², provided by four legs of D13 (507 mm²). Shear strength is V_n = 3.2×10⁶×(0.17×6.48 + 0.0025×420) ≈ 6,886 kN and φV_n = 0.75×6,886 ≈ 5,164 kN. A Class B lap for D25 is about 1,240 mm; lapping all bars at one section would cut boundary clear spacing from about 92 mm to about 27 mm, so laps are staggered or couplers used. If the design drift ratio rises to 0.015, the threshold falls to 8,000/(600×0.0225) ≈ 593 mm, the boundary-element demand becomes clearer, and although the extent remains 550 mm the hinge-zone strains are higher. Values are teaching assumptions, not the design of any real building.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「剪力牆系統與側力傳遞路徑」與「撓曲、軸壓與邊界構材需求」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Shear-wall systems and the lateral load path" and "Flexure, axial load and boundary-element demand": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 剪力牆系統與側力傳遞路徑：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Shear-wall systems and the lateral load path: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「牆體側力分配」如何影響鋼筋混凝土剪力牆施工的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Lateral force share between walls” governs force, deformation or durability in “Reinforced-concrete shear-wall construction”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 樓板像一片水平深梁，把每層的風力或地震慣性力收集起來，再依各牆的相對勁度分配給剪力牆；剪力牆以懸臂方式把剪力與彎矩傳到基礎。牆的勁度與長度三次方成正比，所以長牆分擔絕大多數側力，短牆幾乎只是跟著變形。哈里發塔由三翼各自的高性能混凝土核心牆與中央六角形核心互相扶壁，使整體抗扭勁度很高；這種「牆接牆」的佈置讓側力能在三翼之間互相分擔。施工時任何改變牆長、開口位置或樓板與牆連接的變更，都會改變這條傳力路徑。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「牆體側力分配」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Floors act as horizontal deep beams that collect each storey's wind or seismic inertia force and distribute it to the shear walls in proportion to their stiffness; the walls then carry shear and moment as cantilevers to the foundation. Wall stiffness varies with the cube of length, so long walls take most of the lateral force while short walls largely follow along. At Burj Khalifa each of the three wings has its own high-performance concrete core walls, and these buttress one another through a central hexagonal core, giving very high torsional stiffness; this wall-to-wall arrangement lets lateral force be shared among the wings. During construction, any change to wall length, opening position or the floor-to-wall connection alters this load path. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Lateral force share between walls” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：兩道等厚懸臂牆、長度 8 m 與 4 m，以撓曲控制時勁度比 ∝ L³ = 512 : 64，長牆分擔 512/(512+64) ≈ 89% 的側力。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For two cantilever walls of equal thickness and lengths of 8 m and 4 m, flexure-governed stiffness scales as L³ = 512 : 64, so the long wall takes 512/(512+64) ≈ 89% of the lateral force.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「建築裡每一道牆都平均分擔地震力，所以多加幾道短牆就能有效提高抗震能力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Every wall in a building shares seismic force equally, so adding a few short walls effectively raises seismic capacity." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「牆體側力分配」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Lateral force share between walls”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：建築裡每一道牆都平均分擔地震力，所以多加幾道短牆就能有效提高抗震能力。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Every wall in a building shares seismic force equally, so adding a few short walls effectively raises seismic capacity. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「剪力牆系統與側力傳遞路徑」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Shear-wall systems and the lateral load path" is correct?
options: 建築裡每一道牆都平均分擔地震力，所以多加幾道短牆就能有效提高抗震能力。
樓板像一片水平深梁，把每層的風力或地震慣性力收集起來，再依各牆的相對勁度分配給剪力牆；剪力牆以懸臂方式把剪力與彎矩傳到基礎。
剪力牆主要承受剪力，所以只要水平筋足夠，牆端不需要特別圍束。
optionsEn: Every wall in a building shares seismic force equally, so adding a few short walls effectively raises seismic capacity.
Floors act as horizontal deep beams that collect each storey's wind or seismic inertia force and distribute it to the shear walls in proportion to their stiffness.
Shear walls mainly carry shear, so with enough horizontal bars their ends need no special confinement.
quiz.explanation: 樓板像一片水平深梁，把每層的風力或地震慣性力收集起來，再依各牆的相對勁度分配給剪力牆；剪力牆以懸臂方式把剪力與彎矩傳到基礎。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Floors act as horizontal deep beams that collect each storey's wind or seismic inertia force and distribute it to the shear walls in proportion to their stiffness; the walls then carry shear and moment as cantilevers to the foundation. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 剪力牆系統與側力傳遞路徑：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Shear-wall systems and the lateral load path: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「牆體側力分配」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Lateral force share between walls” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：兩道等厚懸臂牆、長度 8 m 與 4 m，以撓曲控制時勁度比 ∝ L³ = 512 : 64，長牆分擔 512/(512+64) ≈ 89% 的側力。若施工中把長牆中段改為 1.2 m 寬的門洞，牆被分成兩段，勁度與分擔比例都大幅改變，需重新分析。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For two cantilever walls of equal thickness and lengths of 8 m and 4 m, flexure-governed stiffness scales as L³ = 512 : 64, so the long wall takes 512/(512+64) ≈ 89% of the lateral force. If a 1.2 m door is cut into the middle of the long wall during construction, the wall is split in two and both stiffness and share change greatly, requiring re-analysis. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以結構分析模型輸出各牆的剪力與彎矩分擔，與手算勁度比例核對量級；施工圖審查時逐一比對牆長、開口與樓板連接是否與分析模型一致，差異需由結構設計者確認。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Output each wall's share of shear and moment from the structural model and check the order of magnitude against hand stiffness ratios; at shop-drawing review compare wall lengths, openings and floor connections with the analysis model one by one, with any difference confirmed by the structural designer.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

quiz.question: 依「剪力牆系統與側力傳遞路徑」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Shear-wall systems and the lateral load path", which statement holds?
options: 搭接長度只要符合一般構件的要求，用在剪力牆塑性鉸區也一樣安全。
剪力牆用高坍度混凝土就不需要振搗。

optionsEn: A lap length adequate for ordinary members is equally safe in a shear wall's plastic-hinge zone.
Shear walls cast with high-slump concrete do not need vibrating.

steps.title: 剪力牆系統與側力傳遞路徑：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Shear-wall systems and the lateral load path: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「牆體側力分配」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Lateral force share between walls” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以結構分析模型輸出各牆的剪力與彎矩分擔，與手算勁度比例核對量級；施工圖審查時逐一比對牆長、開口與樓板連接是否與分析模型一致，差異需由結構設計者確認。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Output each wall's share of shear and moment from the structural model and check the order of magnitude against hand stiffness ratios; at shop-drawing review compare wall lengths, openings and floor connections with the analysis model one by one, with any difference confirmed by the structural designer. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：施工圖必須明示樓板與剪力牆之間的集力構件、拉桿與錨定長度，並列為澆置前查驗項目；任何牆體開口或牆長變更，須經結構設計者重新分析並書面同意。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Shop drawings must show collectors, drag bars and anchorage lengths between floors and shear walls and include them in pre-pour inspection; any change in wall openings or length needs re-analysis and written approval by the structural designer.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：樓板與牆之間的連接（集力構件、拉桿）不足時，地震中樓板無法把慣性力交給剪力牆，牆體雖然完好，樓板卻從牆上脫開；皇家調查委員會對基督城 CTV 大樓的報告即專章檢討其結構系統與樓板拉桿補強。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If the connections between floors and walls, collectors and drag bars, are inadequate, floors cannot deliver inertia forces to the shear walls in an earthquake, and floors may separate from walls that remain intact; the Royal Commission's report on Christchurch's CTV Building devotes sections to its structural system and the drag-bar retrofit. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.text: 施工圖必須明示樓板與剪力牆之間的集力構件、拉桿與錨定長度，並列為澆置前查驗項目；任何牆體開口或牆長變更，須經結構設計者重新分析並書面同意。
knowledge.textEn: Shop drawings must show collectors, drag bars and anchorage lengths between floors and shear walls and include them in pre-pour inspection; any change in wall openings or length needs re-analysis and written approval by the structural designer.

quiz.question: 要驗證「剪力牆系統與側力傳遞路徑」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Shear-wall systems and the lateral load path"?
options: 以結構分析模型輸出各牆的剪力與彎矩分擔，與手算勁度比例核對量級；施工圖審查時逐一比對牆長、開口與樓板連接是否與分析模型一致，差異需由結構設計者確認。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。

steps.title: 剪力牆系統與側力傳遞路徑：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Shear-wall systems and the lateral load path: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「牆體側力分配」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Lateral force share between walls” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 樓板與牆之間的連接（集力構件、拉桿）不足時，地震中樓板無法把慣性力交給剪力牆，牆體雖然完好，樓板卻從牆上脫開；皇家調查委員會對基督城 CTV 大樓的報告即專章檢討其結構系統與樓板拉桿補強。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If the connections between floors and walls, collectors and drag bars, are inadequate, floors cannot deliver inertia forces to the shear walls in an earthquake, and floors may separate from walls that remain intact; the Royal Commission's report on Christchurch's CTV Building devotes sections to its structural system and the drag-bar retrofit. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：施工時任何改變牆長、開口位置或樓板與牆連接的變更，都會改變這條傳力路徑。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: During construction, any change to wall length, opening position or the floor-to-wall connection alters this load path.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「建築裡每一道牆都平均分擔地震力，所以多加幾道短牆就能有效提高抗震能力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Every wall in a building shares seismic force equally, so adding a few short walls effectively raises seismic capacity." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 撓曲、軸壓與邊界構材需求：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Flexure, axial load and boundary-element demand: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「邊界構材範圍」如何影響鋼筋混凝土剪力牆施工的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Boundary-element extent” governs force, deformation or durability in “Reinforced-concrete shear-wall construction”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 剪力牆在地震中以牆底塑性鉸的撓曲變形消散能量，牆端受壓區的混凝土應變最高。若受壓區深度大、側向變位大，牆端混凝土會壓碎、縱筋挫屈，因此規範要求在需要時設置特殊邊界構材，以密集箍筋圍束牆端。ACI 318-19 以位移為基礎判斷是否需要邊界構材：中性軸深度 c 超過某個與牆長及設計位移相關的門檻時就需設置，並規定其水平延伸範圍。軸壓越高，c 越大，邊界構材越長，這也是為什麼高層下部牆體的端部鋼筋最密。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「邊界構材範圍」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: In an earthquake a shear wall dissipates energy through flexural deformation at a plastic hinge near its base, and the compression zone at the wall end sees the highest concrete strain. With a deep compression zone and large drift, the wall-end concrete crushes and longitudinal bars buckle, so codes require special boundary elements, wall ends confined by closely spaced hoops, where needed. ACI 318-19 uses a displacement-based check: a boundary element is needed when the neutral-axis depth c exceeds a threshold related to wall length and design displacement, and its horizontal extent is specified. Higher axial load increases c and lengthens the boundary element, which is why wall ends in the lower storeys of tall buildings carry the densest steel. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Boundary-element extent” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：ACI 318-19 門檻 c ≥ l_w/[600(1.5δ_u/h_w)]。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: ACI 318-19 threshold c ≥ l_w/[600(1.5δ_u/h_w)].
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「剪力牆主要承受剪力，所以只要水平筋足夠，牆端不需要特別圍束。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Shear walls mainly carry shear, so with enough horizontal bars their ends need no special confinement." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「邊界構材範圍」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Boundary-element extent”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 誤解：剪力牆主要承受剪力，所以只要水平筋足夠，牆端不需要特別圍束。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

quiz.question: 關於「撓曲、軸壓與邊界構材需求」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Flexure, axial load and boundary-element demand" is correct?
options: 剪力牆主要承受剪力，所以只要水平筋足夠，牆端不需要特別圍束。
只要箍筋總量符合計算，彎鉤是 90° 還是 135° 並不重要。
剪力牆在地震中以牆底塑性鉸的撓曲變形消散能量，牆端受壓區的混凝土應變最高。
optionsEn: Shear walls mainly carry shear, so with enough horizontal bars their ends need no special confinement.
As long as the total hoop steel meets the calculation, whether hooks are 90° or 135° does not matter.
In an earthquake a shear wall dissipates energy through flexural deformation at a plastic hinge near its base, and the compression zone at the wall end sees the highest concrete strain.
quiz.explanation: 剪力牆在地震中以牆底塑性鉸的撓曲變形消散能量，牆端受壓區的混凝土應變最高。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: In an earthquake a shear wall dissipates energy through flexural deformation at a plastic hinge near its base, and the compression zone at the wall end sees the highest concrete strain. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 撓曲、軸壓與邊界構材需求：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Flexure, axial load and boundary-element demand: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「邊界構材範圍」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Boundary-element extent” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：ACI 318-19 門檻 c ≥ l_w/[600(1.5δ_u/h_w)]。l_w = 8 m、δ_u/h_w = 0.01 時門檻 = 8,000/(600×0.015) ≈ 889 mm；若分析得 c = 1,100 mm，需要特殊邊界構材，其延伸長度取 max(c − 0.1l_w, c/2) = max(300, 550) = 550 mm。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: ACI 318-19 threshold c ≥ l_w/[600(1.5δ_u/h_w)]. With l_w = 8 m and δ_u/h_w = 0.01 the threshold is 8,000/(600×0.015) ≈ 889 mm; if analysis gives c = 1,100 mm a special boundary element is needed, extending max(c − 0.1l_w, c/2) = max(300, 550) = 550 mm. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以斷面分析（應變相容）在設計軸力與彎矩下求中性軸深度，與規範門檻比較；施工圖審查時確認每一道牆的邊界構材長度、高度範圍與箍筋配置都與計算書一致，並在模板放樣時標出邊界構材範圍。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Find the neutral-axis depth from strain-compatibility section analysis under design axial load and moment and compare with the code threshold; at shop-drawing review confirm that every wall's boundary-element length, height range and hoop layout match the calculations, and mark boundary-element zones during formwork setting-out.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: ACI 318-19 門檻 c ≥ l_w/[600(1.5δ_u/h_w)]。l_w = 8 m、δ_u/h_w = 0.01 時門檻 = 8,000/(600×0.015) ≈ 889 mm；若分析得 c = 1,100 mm，需要特殊邊界構材，其延伸長度取 max(c − 0.1l_w, c/2) = max(300, 550) = 550 mm。數值為教學假設。

With l_w = 8 m and δ_u/h_w = 0.01 the threshold is 8,000/(600×0.015) ≈ 889 mm; if analysis gives c = 1,100 mm a special boundary element is needed, extending max(c − 0.1l_w, c/2) = max(300, 550) = 550 mm. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「撓曲、軸壓與邊界構材需求」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Flexure, axial load and boundary-element demand", which statement holds?
options: 鋼筋放得越多越密，剪力牆就越安全。
混凝土強度平均值合格，就代表每一道剪力牆都合格。

The more and the denser the reinforcement, the safer the shear wall.

steps.title: 撓曲、軸壓與邊界構材需求：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Flexure, axial load and boundary-element demand: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「邊界構材範圍」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Boundary-element extent” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以斷面分析（應變相容）在設計軸力與彎矩下求中性軸深度，與規範門檻比較；施工圖審查時確認每一道牆的邊界構材長度、高度範圍與箍筋配置都與計算書一致，並在模板放樣時標出邊界構材範圍。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Find the neutral-axis depth from strain-compatibility section analysis under design axial load and moment and compare with the code threshold; at shop-drawing review confirm that every wall's boundary-element length, height range and hoop layout match the calculations, and mark boundary-element zones during formwork setting-out. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：施工圖應以獨立的牆端詳圖標示邊界構材範圍、箍筋與繫筋間距及延伸高度，現場以噴漆在模板與鋼筋上標記範圍；邊界構材查驗列為停檢點，由監造逐道簽認。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Shop drawings should give separate wall-end details showing boundary-element extent, hoop and crosstie spacing and height, with the zones spray-marked on forms and steel on site; boundary-element inspection is a hold point signed wall by wall by the resident engineer.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：邊界構材長度不足或只在牆底一層設置，地震中牆端混凝土壓碎、縱筋外挫，牆體失去軸向承載而突然下陷；牆太薄時，即使有箍筋，牆端也可能側向挫屈。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Boundary elements that are too short or provided only at the lowest storey let the wall-end concrete crush and bars buckle outward in an earthquake, so the wall loses axial capacity and drops suddenly; walls that are too thin may buckle laterally at their ends even with hoops. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以斷面分析（應變相容）在設計軸力與彎矩下求中性軸深度，與規範門檻比較；施工圖審查時確認每一道牆的邊界構材長度、高度範圍與箍筋配置都與計算書一致，並在模板放樣時標出邊界構材範圍。
knowledge.textEn: Find the neutral-axis depth from strain-compatibility section analysis under design axial load and moment and compare with the code threshold; at shop-drawing review confirm that every wall's boundary-element length, height range and hoop layout match the calculations, and mark boundary-element zones during formwork setting-out.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 施工圖應以獨立的牆端詳圖標示邊界構材範圍、箍筋與繫筋間距及延伸高度，現場以噴漆在模板與鋼筋上標記範圍；邊界構材查驗列為停檢點，由監造逐道簽認。
knowledge.textEn: Shop drawings should give separate wall-end details showing boundary-element extent, hoop and crosstie spacing and height, with the zones spray-marked on forms and steel on site; boundary-element inspection is a hold point signed wall by wall by the resident engineer.

quiz.question: 要驗證「撓曲、軸壓與邊界構材需求」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Flexure, axial load and boundary-element demand"?

steps.title: 撓曲、軸壓與邊界構材需求：失效診斷

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「邊界構材範圍」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Boundary-element extent” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 邊界構材長度不足或只在牆底一層設置，地震中牆端混凝土壓碎、縱筋外挫，牆體失去軸向承載而突然下陷；牆太薄時，即使有箍筋，牆端也可能側向挫屈。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Boundary elements that are too short or provided only at the lowest storey let the wall-end concrete crush and bars buckle outward in an earthquake, so the wall loses axial capacity and drops suddenly; walls that are too thin may buckle laterally at their ends even with hoops. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：軸壓越高，c 越大，邊界構材越長，這也是為什麼高層下部牆體的端部鋼筋最密。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Higher axial load increases c and lengthens the boundary element, which is why wall ends in the lower storeys of tall buildings carry the densest steel.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「剪力牆主要承受剪力，所以只要水平筋足夠，牆端不需要特別圍束。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Shear walls mainly carry shear, so with enough horizontal bars their ends need no special confinement." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

stages.description: 本階段聚焦「圍束鋼筋量、箍筋形狀與彎鉤」與「縱筋搭接、續接器與塑性鉸區」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Confinement quantity, hoop shape and hooks" and "Lap splices, mechanical couplers and the plastic-hinge zone": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 圍束鋼筋量、箍筋形狀與彎鉤：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Confinement quantity, hoop shape and hooks: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「端部箍筋與繫筋」如何影響鋼筋混凝土剪力牆施工的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Boundary hoops and crossties” governs force, deformation or durability in “Reinforced-concrete shear-wall construction”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 圍束的作用是讓被箍住的核心混凝土在高壓應變下仍能承載，並防止縱筋挫屈。圍束效果取決於箍筋面積、間距、形狀與彎鉤：箍筋需以 135° 彎鉤錨入核心，繫筋要勾住縱筋，並且間距要夠小，使每一根或每隔一根縱筋都受到側向支撐。現場最常見的問題不是鋼筋量不足，而是彎鉤角度不對、繫筋未勾住縱筋，或為了方便澆置而把箍筋間距放寬。這些錯誤在圖面上看不出來，只有在現場查驗才能發現。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「端部箍筋與繫筋」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Confinement lets the confined core carry load at high compressive strain and stops longitudinal bars from buckling. Its effectiveness depends on hoop area, spacing, shape and hooks: hoops must anchor into the core with 135° hooks, crossties must engage longitudinal bars, and spacing must be close enough that every bar or every other bar is laterally supported. The commonest site problems are not too little steel but wrong hook angles, crossties that miss the bars, or hoop spacing opened up to ease concreting. These errors are invisible on drawings and are found only by site inspection. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Boundary hoops and crossties” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：ACI 318 特殊邊界構材 A_sh/(s·b_c) ≥ max[0.3(A_g/A_ch − 1)f′_c/f_yt, 0.09f′_c/f_yt]。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: ACI 318 special boundary elements require A_sh/(s·b_c) ≥ max[0.3(A_g/A_ch − 1)f′_c/f_yt, 0.09f′_c/f_yt].
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要箍筋總量符合計算，彎鉤是 90° 還是 135° 並不重要。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "As long as the total hoop steel meets the calculation, whether hooks are 90° or 135° does not matter." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「端部箍筋與繫筋」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Boundary hoops and crossties”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 圍束鋼筋量、箍筋形狀與彎鉤
knowledge.titleEn: Confinement quantity, hoop shape and hooks

quiz.question: 關於「圍束鋼筋量、箍筋形狀與彎鉤」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

steps.title: 圍束鋼筋量、箍筋形狀與彎鉤：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Confinement quantity, hoop shape and hooks: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「端部箍筋與繫筋」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Boundary hoops and crossties” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：ACI 318 特殊邊界構材 A_sh/(s·b_c) ≥ max[0.3(A_g/A_ch − 1)f′_c/f_yt, 0.09f′_c/f_yt]。f′_c = 42 MPa、f_yt = 420 MPa，邊界 400×600 mm、核心 320×520 mm，A_g/A_ch ≈ 1.442，前式 ≈ 0.0133 控制；s = 100 mm、b_c = 320 mm 時 A_sh ≥ 0.0133×100×320 ≈ 425 mm²，4 肢 D13 提供 507 mm²。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: ACI 318 special boundary elements require A_sh/(s·b_c) ≥ max[0.3(A_g/A_ch − 1)f′_c/f_yt, 0.09f′_c/f_yt]. With f′_c = 42 MPa, f_yt = 420 MPa, a 400×600 mm boundary and a 320×520 mm core, A_g/A_ch ≈ 1.442 and the first term ≈ 0.0133 governs; for s = 100 mm and b_c = 320 mm, A_sh ≥ 0.0133×100×320 ≈ 425 mm², met by four legs of D13 giving 507 mm². Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：現場查驗以捲尺量測箍筋間距（取連續 5 個間距平均並記錄最大值）、檢查彎鉤角度與延伸長度、確認繫筋勾住縱筋；查驗結果拍照並標註牆編號與樓層，與施工圖逐項核對。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: On site measure hoop spacing with a tape, averaging five consecutive spaces and recording the maximum, check hook angles and extensions and confirm that crossties engage the bars; photograph the results labelled by wall number and storey and check them item by item against the shop drawings.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: ACI 318 特殊邊界構材 A_sh/(s·b_c) ≥ max[0.3(A_g/A_ch − 1)f′_c/f_yt, 0.09f′_c/f_yt]。f′_c = 42 MPa、f_yt = 420 MPa，邊界 400×600 mm、核心 320×520 mm，A_g/A_ch ≈ 1.442，前式 ≈ 0.0133 控制；s = 100 mm、b_c = 320 mm 時 A_sh ≥ 0.0133×100×320 ≈ 425 mm²，4 肢 D13 提供 507 mm²。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: ACI 318 special boundary elements require A_sh/(s·b_c) ≥ max[0.3(A_g/A_ch − 1)f′_c/f_yt, 0.09f′_c/f_yt]. With f′_c = 42 MPa, f_yt = 420 MPa, a 400×600 mm boundary and a 320×520 mm core, A_g/A_ch ≈ 1.442 and the first term ≈ 0.0133 governs; for s = 100 mm and b_c = 320 mm, A_sh ≥ 0.0133×100×320 ≈ 425 mm², met by four legs of D13 giving 507 mm². Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 圍束鋼筋量、箍筋形狀與彎鉤：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Confinement quantity, hoop shape and hooks: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「端部箍筋與繫筋」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Boundary hoops and crossties” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 現場查驗以捲尺量測箍筋間距（取連續 5 個間距平均並記錄最大值）、檢查彎鉤角度與延伸長度、確認繫筋勾住縱筋；查驗結果拍照並標註牆編號與樓層，與施工圖逐項核對。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: On site measure hoop spacing with a tape, averaging five consecutive spaces and recording the maximum, check hook angles and extensions and confirm that crossties engage the bars; photograph the results labelled by wall number and storey and check them item by item against the shop drawings. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：鋼筋加工圖要明示所有邊界構材箍筋與繫筋的彎鉤角度與延伸長度，加工廠出貨前抽檢；現場不得以「方便施工」為由調整箍筋間距或彎鉤，任何調整都須設計者書面同意。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Bar-bending schedules must state hook angles and extensions for every boundary hoop and crosstie, with sampling at the fabrication shop before delivery; site crews may not change hoop spacing or hooks for convenience, and any change needs the designer's written approval.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：箍筋以 90° 彎鉤收尾，地震中保護層剝落後彎鉤張開，箍筋失去圍束，牆端混凝土壓碎、縱筋挫屈；繫筋只勾住箍筋而未勾住縱筋，縱筋在反覆載重下向外鼓出。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Hoops finished with 90° hooks open up once the cover spalls in an earthquake, losing confinement so the wall-end concrete crushes and bars buckle; crossties hooked only around hoops and not around longitudinal bars let those bars bow outward under cyclic load. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 現場查驗以捲尺量測箍筋間距（取連續 5 個間距平均並記錄最大值）、檢查彎鉤角度與延伸長度、確認繫筋勾住縱筋；查驗結果拍照並標註牆編號與樓層，與施工圖逐項核對。
knowledge.textEn: On site measure hoop spacing with a tape, averaging five consecutive spaces and recording the maximum, check hook angles and extensions and confirm that crossties engage the bars; photograph the results labelled by wall number and storey and check them item by item against the shop drawings.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 鋼筋加工圖要明示所有邊界構材箍筋與繫筋的彎鉤角度與延伸長度，加工廠出貨前抽檢；現場不得以「方便施工」為由調整箍筋間距或彎鉤，任何調整都須設計者書面同意。
knowledge.textEn: Bar-bending schedules must state hook angles and extensions for every boundary hoop and crosstie, with sampling at the fabrication shop before delivery; site crews may not change hoop spacing or hooks for convenience, and any change needs the designer's written approval.

quiz.question: 要驗證「圍束鋼筋量、箍筋形狀與彎鉤」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Confinement quantity, hoop shape and hooks"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
剪力牆上鑽幾個管線孔不會影響結構安全，不需要結構工程師評估。
現場查驗以捲尺量測箍筋間距（取連續 5 個間距平均並記錄最大值）、檢查彎鉤角度與延伸長度、確認繫筋勾住縱筋；查驗結果拍照並標註牆編號與樓層，與施工圖逐項核對。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Drilling a few services holes in a shear wall does not affect structural safety and needs no structural engineer's assessment.
On site measure hoop spacing with a tape, averaging five consecutive spaces and recording the maximum, check hook angles and extensions and confirm that crossties engage the bars.

quiz.explanationEn: On site measure hoop spacing with a tape, averaging five consecutive spaces and recording the maximum, check hook angles and extensions and confirm that crossties engage the bars; photograph the results labelled by wall number and storey and check them item by item against the shop drawings. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 圍束鋼筋量、箍筋形狀與彎鉤：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Confinement quantity, hoop shape and hooks: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「端部箍筋與繫筋」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Boundary hoops and crossties” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 箍筋以 90° 彎鉤收尾，地震中保護層剝落後彎鉤張開，箍筋失去圍束，牆端混凝土壓碎、縱筋挫屈；繫筋只勾住箍筋而未勾住縱筋，縱筋在反覆載重下向外鼓出。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Hoops finished with 90° hooks open up once the cover spalls in an earthquake, losing confinement so the wall-end concrete crushes and bars buckle; crossties hooked only around hoops and not around longitudinal bars let those bars bow outward under cyclic load. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這些錯誤在圖面上看不出來，只有在現場查驗才能發現。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: These errors are invisible on drawings and are found only by site inspection.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要箍筋總量符合計算，彎鉤是 90° 還是 135° 並不重要。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "As long as the total hoop steel meets the calculation, whether hooks are 90° or 135° does not matter." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「圍束鋼筋量、箍筋形狀與彎鉤」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Confinement quantity, hoop shape and hooks" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 箍筋以 90° 彎鉤收尾，地震中保護層剝落後彎鉤張開，箍筋失去圍束，牆端混凝土壓碎、縱筋挫屈；繫筋只勾住箍筋而未勾住縱筋，縱筋在反覆載重下向外鼓出。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。

optionsEn: Hoops finished with 90° hooks open up once the cover spalls in an earthquake, losing confinement so the wall-end concrete crushes and bars buckle.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.

Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 縱筋搭接、續接器與塑性鉸區：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Lap splices, mechanical couplers and the plastic-hinge zone: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「縱筋續接位置」如何影響鋼筋混凝土剪力牆施工的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Longitudinal splice location” governs force, deformation or durability in “Reinforced-concrete shear-wall construction”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 剪力牆的縱筋必須逐層接續，最常見的是搭接，但搭接需要很長的長度，並使接頭處鋼筋數量加倍。塑性鉸區是地震中鋼筋反覆降伏的位置，搭接在此區容易因保護層剝落而失效，因此規範對塑性鉸區的續接位置與型式有額外限制，常改用可發展鋼筋實際強度的機械式續接器，或把搭接錯開到塑性鉸區以外。續接位置也影響施工：每層澆置高度、模板與鋼筋吊裝順序都需配合續接設計。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「縱筋續接位置」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Wall longitudinal bars must be continued storey by storey, most often by lap splices, but laps need considerable length and double the number of bars at the splice. The plastic-hinge zone is where bars yield repeatedly in an earthquake, and laps there can fail once the cover spalls, so codes impose extra limits on splice location and type in that zone, often using mechanical couplers able to develop the bar's actual strength, or staggering laps outside the hinge region. Splice location also drives construction: lift heights, formwork and rebar lifting sequences must all suit the splice design. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Longitudinal splice location” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：ACI 318 簡化公式 l_d = f_y·ψ/(1.7λ√f′_c)·d_b。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: ACI 318's simplified l_d = f_y·ψ/(1.7λ√f′_c)·d_b with f_y = 420 MPa and f′_c = 42 MPa (√42 ≈ 6.48) gives l_d ≈ 38.1d_b, about 953 mm for D25; a Class B lap is 1.3l_d ≈ 1,240 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「搭接長度只要符合一般構件的要求，用在剪力牆塑性鉸區也一樣安全。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A lap length adequate for ordinary members is equally safe in a shear wall's plastic-hinge zone." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「縱筋續接位置」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Longitudinal splice location”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

quiz.question: 關於「縱筋搭接、續接器與塑性鉸區」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

options: 搭接長度只要符合一般構件的要求，用在剪力牆塑性鉸區也一樣安全。

steps.title: 縱筋搭接、續接器與塑性鉸區：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Lap splices, mechanical couplers and the plastic-hinge zone: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「縱筋續接位置」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Longitudinal splice location” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：ACI 318 簡化公式 l_d = f_y·ψ/(1.7λ√f′_c)·d_b。f_y = 420 MPa、f′_c = 42 MPa（√42 ≈ 6.48）時 l_d ≈ 38.1d_b，D25 約 953 mm；B 類搭接 1.3l_d ≈ 1,240 mm。若同一斷面全部搭接，該處縱筋數量加倍，下一步的鋼筋間距檢核會顯示擁擠問題。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: ACI 318's simplified l_d = f_y·ψ/(1.7λ√f′_c)·d_b with f_y = 420 MPa and f′_c = 42 MPa (√42 ≈ 6.48) gives l_d ≈ 38.1d_b, about 953 mm for D25; a Class B lap is 1.3l_d ≈ 1,240 mm. Lapping every bar at one section doubles the bar count there, which the next unit's spacing check shows to be congested. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：續接器須有符合規範等級的型式試驗報告，現場每批抽樣做拉伸試驗並檢查螺紋或壓接長度；搭接位置與長度在施工圖上標示，查驗時以捲尺量測並確認錯開距離。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Couplers need type-test reports for the required code class, with site samples from each batch tension-tested and thread or swage length checked; mark lap positions and lengths on the shop drawings, and measure laps and stagger distances with a tape during inspection.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 縱筋搭接、續接器與塑性鉸區：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Lap splices, mechanical couplers and the plastic-hinge zone: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「縱筋續接位置」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Longitudinal splice location” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 續接器須有符合規範等級的型式試驗報告，現場每批抽樣做拉伸試驗並檢查螺紋或壓接長度；搭接位置與長度在施工圖上標示，查驗時以捲尺量測並確認錯開距離。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Couplers need type-test reports for the required code class, with site samples from each batch tension-tested and thread or swage length checked; mark lap positions and lengths on the shop drawings, and measure laps and stagger distances with a tape during inspection. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：結構圖應標示塑性鉸區範圍以及該區允許的續接型式；續接器供應商的認證、現場抽樣試驗與鎖緊檢查紀錄要納入品質文件，未經驗收的批次不得使用。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Structural drawings should mark the plastic-hinge zone and the splice types allowed in it; supplier certification, site sample tests and tightening records for couplers belong in the quality file, and unaccepted batches may not be used.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：在塑性鉸區使用一般搭接，地震中保護層剝落、搭接失去握裹，縱筋被拉脫，牆體撓曲強度驟降；使用未經認證的續接器或螺紋未鎖到底，接頭在鋼筋降伏前先破壞。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

steps.title: 鋼筋擁擠、骨材粒徑與模板配合：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Congestion, aggregate size and formwork: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「鋼筋淨間距與骨材」如何影響鋼筋混凝土剪力牆施工的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Clear bar spacing and aggregate” governs force, deformation or durability in “Reinforced-concrete shear-wall construction”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 剪力牆邊界構材中，縱筋、箍筋、繫筋、續接與預埋件集中在很小的斷面內，混凝土必須能從鋼筋間隙流過並包覆每一根鋼筋。若鋼筋淨間距小於粗骨材能通過的寬度，骨材會在鋼筋上架橋，下方形成蜂窩與空洞，正好出現在最需要混凝土的牆端。因此設計與施工必須一起決定鋼筋配置、骨材最大粒徑、是否使用自充填混凝土，以及澆置管或振動棒能否插入。這是設計圖上的鋼筋與現場可施工性之間最常發生衝突的地方。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「鋼筋淨間距與骨材」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: In a shear-wall boundary element, longitudinal bars, hoops, crossties, splices and embeds are packed into a small section, and concrete must flow through the gaps and surround every bar. If clear spacing is less than coarse aggregate can pass, the aggregate bridges across the bars and leaves honeycombing and voids underneath, exactly at the wall ends that most need concrete. Design and construction must therefore settle together the bar layout, maximum aggregate size, whether to use self-consolidating concrete, and whether a tremie or vibrator can be inserted. This is where drawings and site buildability most often collide. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Clear bar spacing and aggregate” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：邊界寬 600 mm，保護層 40 mm、箍筋 D13，排 5 根 D25 時淨間距 = (600 − 80 − 26 − 125)/4 ≈ 92 mm；若同一斷面全部搭接變成 10 根，淨間距 = (600 − 80 − 26 − 250)/9 ≈ 27 mm，粗骨材最大粒徑須 ≤ 0.75×27 ≈ 20 mm，且已接近 25 mm 的最小淨距。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: In a 600 mm boundary with 40 mm cover and D13 hoops, five D25 bars leave a clear spacing of (600 − 80 − 26 − 125)/4 ≈ 92 mm; lapping all of them at one section makes ten bars and (600 − 80 − 26 − 250)/9 ≈ 27 mm, so maximum aggregate must be ≤ 0.75×27 ≈ 20 mm and spacing is close to the 25 mm minimum.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鋼筋放得越多越密，剪力牆就越安全。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The more and the denser the reinforcement, the safer the shear wall." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.

steps.title: 鋼筋擁擠、骨材粒徑與模板配合：定量估算

steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: In a 600 mm boundary with 40 mm cover and D13 hoops, five D25 bars leave a clear spacing of (600 − 80 − 26 − 125)/4 ≈ 92 mm; lapping all of them at one section makes ten bars and (600 − 80 − 26 − 250)/9 ≈ 27 mm, so maximum aggregate must be ≤ 0.75×27 ≈ 20 mm and spacing is close to the 25 mm minimum. Staggering laps or using couplers restores about 92 mm. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check the most congested sections of boundary elements, usually at laps and at floor intersections, with a 3D rebar model or a full-size mock-up, confirming clear spacing, vibrator insertion paths and tremie positions; where needed cast a full-size specimen and cut it open to check compaction.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.title: 分層澆置、振搗與蜂窩防止：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Layered placing, vibration and preventing honeycombing: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「分層澆置與振搗」如何影響鋼筋混凝土剪力牆施工的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Layered placing and vibration” governs force, deformation or durability in “Reinforced-concrete shear-wall construction”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 剪力牆又高又薄，混凝土從頂部落下時容易析離，粗骨材先落到底部堆積，砂漿留在上方；因此牆體澆置要以澆置管或軟管伸入模板內，控制自由落差，並分層澆置、逐層振搗。振動棒必須插入下層約 100 mm 使兩層結合，插入間距要小於作用半徑的 1.5 倍，並在牆端邊界構材、開口下方與施工縫等容易缺漿的位置加強振搗。亞特蘭大試驗塔的外牆厚約 460 mm、內牆約 250 mm，薄牆中振動棒的操作空間更小。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「分層澆置與振搗」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Shear walls are tall and thin, and concrete dropped from the top segregates easily, with coarse aggregate piling at the bottom and mortar staying above; walls are therefore placed through a tremie or hose lowered into the form to limit free fall, in layers vibrated one by one. The vibrator must penetrate about 100 mm into the layer below to knit the layers together, with insertion spacing less than 1.5 times its radius of action, and extra attention at boundary elements, under openings and at construction joints where paste is easily lacking. The Atlanta test tower's exterior walls were about 460 mm thick and its interior walls about 250 mm, leaving even less room to work a vibrator in the thinner walls. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Layered placing and vibration” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：振動棒作用半徑 300 mm 時插入間距 ≤ 1.5×300 = 450 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With a 300 mm radius of action, insertion spacing is ≤ 1.5×300 = 450 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「剪力牆用高坍度混凝土就不需要振搗。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Shear walls cast with high-slump concrete do not need vibrating." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「分層澆置與振搗」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Layered placing and vibration”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 分層澆置、振搗與蜂窩防止：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Layered placing, vibration and preventing honeycombing: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「分層澆置與振搗」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Layered placing and vibration” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：振動棒作用半徑 300 mm 時插入間距 ≤ 1.5×300 = 450 mm。8 m 長牆每層需 8/0.45 ≈ 17.8，取 18 個插入點；層厚 0.5 m、牆高 3.6 m 需約 8 層（最後一層較薄），共約 144 次插入，每次 10 s，約 24 分鐘純振搗時間，人力與振動棒數量要據此安排。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With a 300 mm radius of action, insertion spacing is ≤ 1.5×300 = 450 mm. An 8 m wall needs 8/0.45 ≈ 17.8, so 18 insertions per layer; 0.5 m layers over 3.6 m of height need about 8 layers (the last one thinner), about 144 insertions at 10 s each, roughly 24 minutes of vibrating, and crews and vibrators should be planned on that basis. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：澆置前確認澆置管長度可伸到距底部 1.5 m 以內、振動棒數量與備品足夠；澆置中由專人記錄每層高度與振搗位置，拆模後全面目視檢查蜂窩、冷縫與砂紋，缺陷按程序記錄與修補。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before placing confirm that the tremie reaches within 1.5 m of the bottom and that there are enough vibrators and spares; during placing a designated person records each layer height and vibration positions, and after stripping inspect the whole surface for honeycombing, cold joints and sand streaks, recording and repairing defects by procedure.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

An 8 m wall needs 8/0.45 ≈ 17.8, so 18 insertions per layer; 0.5 m layers over 3.6 m of height need about 8 layers (the last one thinner), about 144 insertions at 10 s each, roughly 24 minutes of vibrating, and crews and vibrators should be planned on that basis. steps.title: 分層澆置、振搗與蜂窩防止：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Layered placing, vibration and preventing honeycombing: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「分層澆置與振搗」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Layered placing and vibration” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 澆置前確認澆置管長度可伸到距底部 1.5 m 以內、振動棒數量與備品足夠；澆置中由專人記錄每層高度與振搗位置，拆模後全面目視檢查蜂窩、冷縫與砂紋，缺陷按程序記錄與修補。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before placing confirm that the tremie reaches within 1.5 m of the bottom and that there are enough vibrators and spares; during placing a designated person records each layer height and vibration positions, and after stripping inspect the whole surface for honeycombing, cold joints and sand streaks, recording and repairing defects by procedure. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：澆置計畫須標示每道牆的澆置點、分層厚度、振動棒數量與負責人員；若改用自充填混凝土，須另做樣板試驗確認填充性與模板側壓，並經設計者同意。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The placing plan should mark pour points, layer thickness, number of vibrators and responsible crew for each wall; switching to self-consolidating concrete requires mock-up trials of filling ability and form pressure and the designer's approval.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：從樓板高度直接把混凝土倒入 3 m 以上的牆模，底部骨材堆積、上方砂漿過多，牆底與樓板交界形成蜂窩帶；振動棒未插入下層，兩層之間形成弱面，在地震中沿該面滑移或滲水。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Dumping concrete from slab level into wall forms over 3 m high piles aggregate at the bottom with excess mortar above, leaving a honeycomb band at the wall–slab junction; vibrators that do not enter the lower layer leave a weak plane between lifts that can slip or leak in an earthquake. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: Before placing confirm that the tremie reaches within 1.5 m of the bottom and that there are enough vibrators and spares; during placing a designated person records each layer height and vibration positions, and after stripping inspect the whole surface for honeycombing, cold joints and sand streaks, recording and repairing defects by procedure.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 澆置計畫須標示每道牆的澆置點、分層厚度、振動棒數量與負責人員；若改用自充填混凝土，須另做樣板試驗確認填充性與模板側壓，並經設計者同意。
knowledge.textEn: The placing plan should mark pour points, layer thickness, number of vibrators and responsible crew for each wall; switching to self-consolidating concrete requires mock-up trials of filling ability and form pressure and the designer's approval.

quiz.question: 要驗證「分層澆置、振搗與蜂窩防止」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Layered placing, vibration and preventing honeycombing"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
只要箍筋總量符合計算，彎鉤是 90° 還是 135° 並不重要。
澆置前確認澆置管長度可伸到距底部 1.5 m 以內、振動棒數量與備品足夠。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
As long as the total hoop steel meets the calculation, whether hooks are 90° or 135° does not matter.
Before placing confirm that the tremie reaches within 1.5 m of the bottom and that there are enough vibrators and spares.
quiz.explanation: 澆置前確認澆置管長度可伸到距底部 1.5 m 以內、振動棒數量與備品足夠；澆置中由專人記錄每層高度與振搗位置，拆模後全面目視檢查蜂窩、冷縫與砂紋，缺陷按程序記錄與修補。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Before placing confirm that the tremie reaches within 1.5 m of the bottom and that there are enough vibrators and spares; during placing a designated person records each layer height and vibration positions, and after stripping inspect the whole surface for honeycombing, cold joints and sand streaks, recording and repairing defects by procedure. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 分層澆置、振搗與蜂窩防止：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Layered placing, vibration and preventing honeycombing: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「分層澆置與振搗」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Layered placing and vibration” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 從樓板高度直接把混凝土倒入 3 m 以上的牆模，底部骨材堆積、上方砂漿過多，牆底與樓板交界形成蜂窩帶；振動棒未插入下層，兩層之間形成弱面，在地震中沿該面滑移或滲水。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Dumping concrete from slab level into wall forms over 3 m high piles aggregate at the bottom with excess mortar above, leaving a honeycomb band at the wall–slab junction; vibrators that do not enter the lower layer leave a weak plane between lifts that can slip or leak in an earthquake. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：亞特蘭大試驗塔的外牆厚約 460 mm、內牆約 250 mm，薄牆中振動棒的操作空間更小。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The Atlanta test tower's exterior walls were about 460 mm thick and its interior walls about 250 mm, leaving even less room to work a vibrator in the thinner walls.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「剪力牆用高坍度混凝土就不需要振搗。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Shear walls cast with high-slump concrete do not need vibrating." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 從樓板高度直接把混凝土倒入 3 m 以上的牆模，底部骨材堆積、上方砂漿過多，牆底與樓板交界形成蜂窩帶；振動棒未插入下層，兩層之間形成弱面，在地震中沿該面滑移或滲水。

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「分層澆置、振搗與蜂窩防止」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Layered placing, vibration and preventing honeycombing" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 從樓板高度直接把混凝土倒入 3 m 以上的牆模，底部骨材堆積、上方砂漿過多，牆底與樓板交界形成蜂窩帶。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
混凝土強度平均值合格，就代表每一道剪力牆都合格。
optionsEn: Dumping concrete from slab level into wall forms over 3 m high piles aggregate at the bottom with excess mortar above, leaving a honeycomb band at the wall–slab junction.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
If the average concrete strength passes, every shear wall passes.
quiz.explanation: 從樓板高度直接把混凝土倒入 3 m 以上的牆模，底部骨材堆積、上方砂漿過多，牆底與樓板交界形成蜂窩帶；振動棒未插入下層，兩層之間形成弱面，在地震中沿該面滑移或滲水。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Dumping concrete from slab level into wall forms over 3 m high piles aggregate at the bottom with excess mortar above, leaving a honeycomb band at the wall–slab junction; vibrators that do not enter the lower layer leave a weak plane between lifts that can slip or leak in an earthquake. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「強度驗收、鑽心試驗與非破壞檢測」與「澆置前查驗與保護層量測」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Strength acceptance, cores and non-destructive testing" and "Pre-pour inspection and cover measurement": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 強度驗收、鑽心試驗與非破壞檢測：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Strength acceptance, cores and non-destructive testing: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「混凝土強度與鑽心」如何影響鋼筋混凝土剪力牆施工的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Concrete strength and cores” governs force, deformation or durability in “Reinforced-concrete shear-wall construction”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 剪力牆的混凝土強度直接影響邊界構材需求、剪力強度與鋼筋握裹，因此驗收不能只看平均值。ACI 318 的驗收規則同時要求連續三組試驗的平均值達到規定強度，以及單組不得低於某個下限，前者控制整體品質，後者抓出個別不良批次。若試體結果不合格，要先檢討取樣與試驗程序，再以鑽心試驗評估結構中的實際強度；回彈錘或超音波等非破壞檢測可用來找出可疑區域與決定鑽心位置，但不能取代鑽心。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「混凝土強度與鑽心」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Shear-wall concrete strength directly affects boundary-element demand, shear strength and bond, so acceptance cannot rest on the average alone. ACI 318 acceptance requires both that every three consecutive tests average at least the specified strength and that no single test falls below a lower bound; the first controls overall quality and the second catches individual bad batches. If specimens fail, first review sampling and testing, then assess in-place strength by coring; rebound hammer or ultrasonic tests help locate suspect zones and choose core locations but cannot replace cores. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Concrete strength and cores” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：f′_c = 42 MPa（大於 35 MPa）時，單組下限為 0.9f′_c = 37.8 MPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With f′_c = 42 MPa (above 35 MPa) the single-test lower bound is 0.9f′_c = 37.8 MPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「混凝土強度平均值合格，就代表每一道剪力牆都合格。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If the average concrete strength passes, every shear wall passes." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「混凝土強度與鑽心」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Concrete strength and cores”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 強度驗收、鑽心試驗與非破壞檢測
knowledge.titleEn: Strength acceptance, cores and non-destructive testing
knowledge.text: 剪力牆的混凝土強度直接影響邊界構材需求、剪力強度與鋼筋握裹，因此驗收不能只看平均值。ACI 318 的驗收規則同時要求連續三組試驗的平均值達到規定強度，以及單組不得低於某個下限，前者控制整體品質，後者抓出個別不良批次。
knowledge.textEn: Shear-wall concrete strength directly affects boundary-element demand, shear strength and bond, so acceptance cannot rest on the average alone. ACI 318 acceptance requires both that every three consecutive tests average at least the specified strength and that no single test falls below a lower bound; the first controls overall quality and the second catches individual bad batches.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：混凝土強度平均值合格，就代表每一道剪力牆都合格。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If the average concrete strength passes, every shear wall passes. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「強度驗收、鑽心試驗與非破壞檢測」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Strength acceptance, cores and non-destructive testing" is correct?
options: 混凝土強度平均值合格，就代表每一道剪力牆都合格。
剪力牆的混凝土強度直接影響邊界構材需求、剪力強度與鋼筋握裹，因此驗收不能只看平均值。
鋼筋綁好後只要數量對，保護層多一點少一點無所謂。
optionsEn: If the average concrete strength passes, every shear wall passes.
Shear-wall concrete strength directly affects boundary-element demand, shear strength and bond, so acceptance cannot rest on the average alone.
Once the bars are tied, a little more or less cover makes no difference as long as the bar count is right.
quiz.explanation: 剪力牆的混凝土強度直接影響邊界構材需求、剪力強度與鋼筋握裹，因此驗收不能只看平均值。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Shear-wall concrete strength directly affects boundary-element demand, shear strength and bond, so acceptance cannot rest on the average alone. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 強度驗收、鑽心試驗與非破壞檢測：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Strength acceptance, cores and non-destructive testing: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「混凝土強度與鑽心」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Concrete strength and cores” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：f′_c = 42 MPa（大於 35 MPa）時，單組下限為 0.9f′_c = 37.8 MPa。假設三組結果 44.1、40.2、38.5 MPa：平均 40.9 MPa < 42 MPa 不合格，單組皆 ≥ 37.8 MPa。鑽心評估：三個鑽心平均須 ≥ 0.85f′_c = 35.7 MPa，且單一不低於 0.75f′_c = 31.5 MPa。數值為教學假設，不是任何專案的試驗資料。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With f′_c = 42 MPa (above 35 MPa) the single-test lower bound is 0.9f′_c = 37.8 MPa. Assume three results of 44.1, 40.2 and 38.5 MPa: the average of 40.9 MPa is below 42 MPa and fails, while each single test is ≥ 37.8 MPa. For cores, three cores must average ≥ 0.85f′_c = 35.7 MPa with none below 0.75f′_c = 31.5 MPa. Values are teaching assumptions, not test data from any project. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：依規範頻率取樣並記錄每組對應的牆體與樓層；不合格時先以回彈或超音波掃描找出低值區，再於避開邊界構材主筋的位置鑽心，鑽心依規定的含水狀態試驗並修正長徑比，結果由結構設計者評估是否需補強。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Sample at the code frequency and record which wall and storey each test represents; when a result fails, scan with rebound or ultrasonics to find low zones, core in locations that avoid main boundary bars, test cores in the specified moisture condition with length-to-diameter corrections, and have the structural designer decide whether strengthening is needed.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: f′_c = 42 MPa（大於 35 MPa）時，單組下限為 0.9f′_c = 37.8 MPa。假設三組結果 44.1、40.2、38.5 MPa：平均 40.9 MPa < 42 MPa 不合格，單組皆 ≥ 37.8 MPa。鑽心評估：三個鑽心平均須 ≥ 0.85f′_c = 35.7 MPa，且單一不低於 0.75f′_c = 31.5 MPa。數值為教學假設，不是任何專案的試驗資料。
knowledge.textEn: With f′_c = 42 MPa (above 35 MPa) the single-test lower bound is 0.9f′_c = 37.8 MPa. Assume three results of 44.1, 40.2 and 38.5 MPa: the average of 40.9 MPa is below 42 MPa and fails, while each single test is ≥ 37.8 MPa. For cores, three cores must average ≥ 0.85f′_c = 35.7 MPa with none below 0.75f′_c = 31.5 MPa. Values are teaching assumptions, not test data from any project.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「強度驗收、鑽心試驗與非破壞檢測」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Strength acceptance, cores and non-destructive testing", which statement holds?
options: 剪力牆上鑽幾個管線孔不會影響結構安全，不需要結構工程師評估。
剪力牆主要承受剪力，所以只要水平筋足夠，牆端不需要特別圍束。
f′_c = 42 MPa（大於 35 MPa）時，單組下限為 0.9f′_c = 37.8 MPa。
optionsEn: Drilling a few services holes in a shear wall does not affect structural safety and needs no structural engineer's assessment.
Shear walls mainly carry shear, so with enough horizontal bars their ends need no special confinement.

steps.title: 強度驗收、鑽心試驗與非破壞檢測：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Strength acceptance, cores and non-destructive testing: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「混凝土強度與鑽心」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Concrete strength and cores” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 依規範頻率取樣並記錄每組對應的牆體與樓層；不合格時先以回彈或超音波掃描找出低值區，再於避開邊界構材主筋的位置鑽心，鑽心依規定的含水狀態試驗並修正長徑比，結果由結構設計者評估是否需補強。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Sample at the code frequency and record which wall and storey each test represents; when a result fails, scan with rebound or ultrasonics to find low zones, core in locations that avoid main boundary bars, test cores in the specified moisture condition with length-to-diameter corrections, and have the structural designer decide whether strengthening is needed. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.observationEn: Site practice: Strength records must trace to each wall's pour location and truck; write the nonconformance procedure (retest, non-destructive testing, coring, structural assessment, strengthening) into the quality plan in advance with a hold point, and do not continue building above a wall until its assessment is complete.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：試體在工地曝曬或搬運不當而強度偏低，誤判結構不合格；反之，只看平均值而忽略某一批次明顯偏低，該批次正好用在底層剪力牆的邊界構材，日後在地震中成為最弱處。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Specimens left in the sun or mishandled read low and wrongly condemn the structure; conversely, watching only the average while ignoring one clearly low batch, used precisely in a ground-storey boundary element, leaves the weakest point where earthquakes hit hardest. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
