steps.title: 強度驗收、鑽心試驗與非破壞檢測：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Strength acceptance, cores and non-destructive testing: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「混凝土強度與鑽心」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Concrete strength and cores” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 試體在工地曝曬或搬運不當而強度偏低，誤判結構不合格；反之，只看平均值而忽略某一批次明顯偏低，該批次正好用在底層剪力牆的邊界構材，日後在地震中成為最弱處。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Specimens left in the sun or mishandled read low and wrongly condemn the structure; conversely, watching only the average while ignoring one clearly low batch, used precisely in a ground-storey boundary element, leaves the weakest point where earthquakes hit hardest. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若試體結果不合格，要先檢討取樣與試驗程序，再以鑽心試驗評估結構中的實際強度；回彈錘或超音波等非破壞檢測可用來找出可疑區域與決定鑽心位置，但不能取代鑽心。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If specimens fail, first review sampling and testing, then assess in-place strength by coring; rebound hammer or ultrasonic tests help locate suspect zones and choose core locations but cannot replace cores.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「混凝土強度平均值合格，就代表每一道剪力牆都合格。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If the average concrete strength passes, every shear wall passes." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 試體在工地曝曬或搬運不當而強度偏低，誤判結構不合格；反之，只看平均值而忽略某一批次明顯偏低，該批次正好用在底層剪力牆的邊界構材，日後在地震中成為最弱處。
knowledge.textEn: Specimens left in the sun or mishandled read low and wrongly condemn the structure; conversely, watching only the average while ignoring one clearly low batch, used precisely in a ground-storey boundary element, leaves the weakest point where earthquakes hit hardest.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「強度驗收、鑽心試驗與非破壞檢測」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Strength acceptance, cores and non-destructive testing" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
試體在工地曝曬或搬運不當而強度偏低，誤判結構不合格；反之，只看平均值而忽略某一批次明顯偏低，該批次正好用在底層剪力牆的邊界構材，日後在地震中成為最弱處。
鋼筋綁好後只要數量對，保護層多一點少一點無所謂。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Specimens left in the sun or mishandled read low and wrongly condemn the structure.
Once the bars are tied, a little more or less cover makes no difference as long as the bar count is right.
quiz.explanation: 試體在工地曝曬或搬運不當而強度偏低，誤判結構不合格；反之，只看平均值而忽略某一批次明顯偏低，該批次正好用在底層剪力牆的邊界構材，日後在地震中成為最弱處。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Specimens left in the sun or mishandled read low and wrongly condemn the structure; conversely, watching only the average while ignoring one clearly low batch, used precisely in a ground-storey boundary element, leaves the weakest point where earthquakes hit hardest. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 澆置前查驗與保護層量測：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Pre-pour inspection and cover measurement: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「保護層與鋼筋查驗」如何影響鋼筋混凝土剪力牆施工的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Cover and rebar inspection” governs force, deformation or durability in “Reinforced-concrete shear-wall construction”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 剪力牆合模之後鋼筋就看不到了，所以澆置前查驗是確認設計意圖的最後機會。查驗清單包括：鋼筋號數、數量與間距、邊界構材範圍與箍筋、彎鉤、續接位置與長度、樓板拉桿與集力構件、預埋件與開口補強、保護層墊塊與鋼筋固定、施工縫清潔。保護層不足會讓鋼筋提早鏽蝕並降低耐火性；保護層過大則減少有效深度與圍束效果。查驗應以檢查表逐項進行，並保留照片與簽名紀錄。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「保護層與鋼筋查驗」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Once wall forms close, the reinforcement disappears, so the pre-pour inspection is the last chance to confirm the design intent. The checklist covers bar sizes, numbers and spacing, boundary-element extent and hoops, hooks, splice locations and lengths, floor drag bars and collectors, embeds and reinforcement around openings, cover spacers and bar fixing, and cleanliness of construction joints. Too little cover lets bars corrode early and reduces fire resistance; too much reduces effective depth and confinement. Inspection should follow the checklist item by item with photographs and signatures kept on record. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Cover and rebar inspection” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：ACI 318 對有效深度大於 200 mm 的構件，保護層容許負誤差 13 mm，且減少量不得超過規定保護層的 1/3。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For members with effective depth over 200 mm, ACI 318 allows a cover tolerance of −13 mm, with the reduction not exceeding one third of the specified cover.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鋼筋綁好後只要數量對，保護層多一點少一點無所謂。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Once the bars are tied, a little more or less cover makes no difference as long as the bar count is right." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「保護層與鋼筋查驗」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Cover and rebar inspection”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 澆置前查驗與保護層量測

The checklist covers bar sizes, numbers and spacing, boundary-element extent and hoops, hooks, splice locations and lengths, floor drag bars and collectors, embeds and reinforcement around openings, cover spacers and bar fixing, and cleanliness of construction joints.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：鋼筋綁好後只要數量對，保護層多一點少一點無所謂。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Once the bars are tied, a little more or less cover makes no difference as long as the bar count is right. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「澆置前查驗與保護層量測」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Pre-pour inspection and cover measurement" is correct?
options: 鋼筋綁好後只要數量對，保護層多一點少一點無所謂。
震後剪力牆裂縫只要灌注環氧樹脂，就能恢復原來的耐震能力。
剪力牆合模之後鋼筋就看不到了，所以澆置前查驗是確認設計意圖的最後機會。
optionsEn: Once the bars are tied, a little more or less cover makes no difference as long as the bar count is right.
Injecting epoxy into post-earthquake shear-wall cracks restores the original seismic capacity.

quiz.explanation: 剪力牆合模之後鋼筋就看不到了，所以澆置前查驗是確認設計意圖的最後機會。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Once wall forms close, the reinforcement disappears, so the pre-pour inspection is the last chance to confirm the design intent. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 澆置前查驗與保護層量測：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Pre-pour inspection and cover measurement: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「保護層與鋼筋查驗」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Cover and rebar inspection” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：ACI 318 對有效深度大於 200 mm 的構件，保護層容許負誤差 13 mm，且減少量不得超過規定保護層的 1/3。規定保護層 40 mm 時最小允許值 = max(40 − 13, 2/3×40) = max(27, 26.7) = 27 mm。若 52 個量測點中有 3 點低於 27 mm（約 5.8%），須在澆置前調整墊塊。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For members with effective depth over 200 mm, ACI 318 allows a cover tolerance of −13 mm, with the reduction not exceeding one third of the specified cover. For 40 mm specified cover the minimum allowed is max(40 − 13, 2/3×40) = max(27, 26.7) = 27 mm. If 3 of 52 readings fall below 27 mm, about 5.8%, the spacers must be adjusted before pouring. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：合模前由鋼筋承包商自主檢查，再由監造依檢查表查驗並拍照，每一道牆有獨立紀錄；合模後以手持式保護層測定儀從模板開口或拆模後抽測保護層，結果與查驗紀錄比對。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before closing forms the rebar contractor self-inspects and the resident engineer then inspects against the checklist with photographs, keeping a separate record for every wall; after closing or stripping, sample cover with a handheld covermeter and compare with the inspection record.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: ACI 318 對有效深度大於 200 mm 的構件，保護層容許負誤差 13 mm，且減少量不得超過規定保護層的 1/3。規定保護層 40 mm 時最小允許值 = max(40 − 13, 2/3×40) = max(27, 26.7) = 27 mm。若 52 個量測點中有 3 點低於 27 mm（約 5.8%），須在澆置前調整墊塊。數值為教學假設。

For 40 mm specified cover the minimum allowed is max(40 − 13, 2/3×40) = max(27, 26.7) = 27 mm. If 3 of 52 readings fall below 27 mm, about 5.8%, the spacers must be adjusted before pouring. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「澆置前查驗與保護層量測」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Pre-pour inspection and cover measurement", which statement holds?

steps.title: 澆置前查驗與保護層量測：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Pre-pour inspection and cover measurement: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「保護層與鋼筋查驗」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。

steps.instruction: 合模前由鋼筋承包商自主檢查，再由監造依檢查表查驗並拍照，每一道牆有獨立紀錄；合模後以手持式保護層測定儀從模板開口或拆模後抽測保護層，結果與查驗紀錄比對。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before closing forms the rebar contractor self-inspects and the resident engineer then inspects against the checklist with photographs, keeping a separate record for every wall; after closing or stripping, sample cover with a handheld covermeter and compare with the inspection record. steps.failure: 注意干擾：查驗流於形式只看主筋數量，未注意樓板拉桿漏放、開口周邊補強筋缺少或墊塊被踩壞，合模後才發現已無法補救；保護層不足的牆面數年後出現鏽水與剝落，修補成本遠高於當初調整墊塊。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.

steps.title: 震後損傷判讀、修復與補強：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Post-earthquake damage interpretation, repair and strengthening: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「震後裂縫與鋼筋應變」如何影響鋼筋混凝土剪力牆施工的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Post-earthquake cracks and bar strain” governs force, deformation or durability in “Reinforced-concrete shear-wall construction”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 地震後剪力牆的損傷可從裂縫型態判讀：水平裂縫集中在牆底表示撓曲作用，斜裂縫表示剪力作用，牆端保護層剝落、縱筋外露或挫屈表示邊界構材已達高應變，牆端壓碎則是嚴重損傷。殘留裂縫寬度可以粗略推估鋼筋是否已降伏：若裂縫在地震後仍明顯張開，表示鋼筋可能已產生塑性變形。修復策略從環氧樹脂灌注、局部置換混凝土，到以鋼板、纖維複合材料或增設牆體補強，需依損傷程度與殘餘能力決定，而不是只看外觀。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「震後裂縫與鋼筋應變」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: After an earthquake, shear-wall damage can be read from crack patterns: horizontal cracks concentrated at the base indicate flexure, diagonal cracks indicate shear, spalled cover with exposed or buckled bars at wall ends shows the boundary element reached high strain, and crushing at the wall end is severe damage. Residual crack width gives a rough indication of whether bars have yielded: cracks that stay clearly open after shaking suggest plastic deformation in the steel. Repair ranges from epoxy injection and local concrete replacement to strengthening with steel plates, fibre composites or added walls, chosen by damage level and residual capacity rather than appearance alone. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Post-earthquake cracks and bar strain” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以裂縫間距估算鋼筋平均應變 ε ≈ w/s_cr。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Average bar strain can be estimated from crack spacing as ε ≈ w/s_cr.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「震後剪力牆裂縫只要灌注環氧樹脂，就能恢復原來的耐震能力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Injecting epoxy into post-earthquake shear-wall cracks restores the original seismic capacity." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「震後裂縫與鋼筋應變」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 震後損傷判讀、修復與補強：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Post-earthquake damage interpretation, repair and strengthening: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「震後裂縫與鋼筋應變」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Post-earthquake cracks and bar strain” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以裂縫間距估算鋼筋平均應變 ε ≈ w/s_cr。殘留裂縫寬 0.6 mm、間距 200 mm 時 ε ≈ 0.6/200 = 0.003，大於 f_y = 420 MPa 鋼筋的降伏應變 420/200,000 = 0.0021，表示鋼筋很可能已降伏，需要工程評估而非只做表面修補。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Average bar strain can be estimated from crack spacing as ε ≈ w/s_cr. A residual crack of 0.6 mm at 200 mm spacing gives ε ≈ 0.6/200 = 0.003, above the yield strain of 420/200,000 = 0.0021 for f_y = 420 MPa, so the bars have probably yielded and an engineering assessment, not just surface repair, is needed. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：震後以裂縫寬度計與裂縫圖記錄每道牆的裂縫位置、方向與寬度，必要時打開保護層檢查鋼筋是否挫屈或斷裂，並以結構分析評估殘餘能力；修復後以灌注紀錄、鑽心或超音波確認灌注效果。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: After an earthquake record crack location, direction and width for each wall with crack gauges and crack maps, open the cover where needed to check for buckled or fractured bars, and assess residual capacity by structural analysis; after repair confirm injection quality from injection records, cores or ultrasonics.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以裂縫間距估算鋼筋平均應變 ε ≈ w/s_cr。殘留裂縫寬 0.6 mm、間距 200 mm 時 ε ≈ 0.6/200 = 0.003，大於 f_y = 420 MPa 鋼筋的降伏應變 420/200,000 = 0.0021，表示鋼筋很可能已降伏，需要工程評估而非只做表面修補。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Average bar strain can be estimated from crack spacing as ε ≈ w/s_cr. A residual crack of 0.6 mm at 200 mm spacing gives ε ≈ 0.6/200 = 0.003, above the yield strain of 420/200,000 = 0.0021 for f_y = 420 MPa, so the bars have probably yielded and an engineering assessment, not just surface repair, is needed. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「震後損傷判讀、修復與補強」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

optionsEn: Shear walls mainly carry shear, so with enough horizontal bars their ends need no special confinement.
Average bar strain can be estimated from crack spacing as ε ≈ w/s_cr.
A lap length adequate for ordinary members is equally safe in a shear wall's plastic-hinge zone.

steps.title: 震後損傷判讀、修復與補強：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Post-earthquake damage interpretation, repair and strengthening: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「震後裂縫與鋼筋應變」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Post-earthquake cracks and bar strain” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 震後以裂縫寬度計與裂縫圖記錄每道牆的裂縫位置、方向與寬度，必要時打開保護層檢查鋼筋是否挫屈或斷裂，並以結構分析評估殘餘能力；修復後以灌注紀錄、鑽心或超音波確認灌注效果。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: After an earthquake record crack location, direction and width for each wall with crack gauges and crack maps, open the cover where needed to check for buckled or fractured bars, and assess residual capacity by structural analysis; after repair confirm injection quality from injection records, cores or ultrasonics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：震後評估應由結構技師依損傷分級程序進行，記錄每道牆的損傷照片與量測值，並與原設計及竣工資料比對；修復或補強設計須經結構審查，施工中設停檢點確認鋼筋狀況。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Post-earthquake assessment should be done by a structural engineer following a damage-classification procedure, recording photos and measurements for every wall and comparing them with the original design and as-built records; repair or strengthening designs need structural review, with hold points during work to confirm reinforcement condition.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只以環氧樹脂灌注把裂縫填滿就宣告修復，卻未檢查已挫屈或疲勞的縱筋，下一次地震時牆端在原位置迅速破壞；修補時鑿除混凝土過深，切斷或損傷原有箍筋，反而降低圍束。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Declaring a wall repaired after merely filling cracks with epoxy, without checking for buckled or fatigued longitudinal bars, lets the wall end fail quickly at the same spot in the next earthquake; breaking out too deep during repair cuts or damages existing hoops and reduces confinement. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「震後損傷判讀、修復與補強」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

steps.title: 震後損傷判讀、修復與補強：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Post-earthquake damage interpretation, repair and strengthening: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「震後裂縫與鋼筋應變」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Post-earthquake cracks and bar strain” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只以環氧樹脂灌注把裂縫填滿就宣告修復，卻未檢查已挫屈或疲勞的縱筋，下一次地震時牆端在原位置迅速破壞；修補時鑿除混凝土過深，切斷或損傷原有箍筋，反而降低圍束。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Declaring a wall repaired after merely filling cracks with epoxy, without checking for buckled or fatigued longitudinal bars, lets the wall end fail quickly at the same spot in the next earthquake; breaking out too deep during repair cuts or damages existing hoops and reduces confinement. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：修復策略從環氧樹脂灌注、局部置換混凝土，到以鋼板、纖維複合材料或增設牆體補強，需依損傷程度與殘餘能力決定，而不是只看外觀。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Repair ranges from epoxy injection and local concrete replacement to strengthening with steel plates, fibre composites or added walls, chosen by damage level and residual capacity rather than appearance alone.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「震後剪力牆裂縫只要灌注環氧樹脂，就能恢復原來的耐震能力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Injecting epoxy into post-earthquake shear-wall cracks restores the original seismic capacity." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 只以環氧樹脂灌注把裂縫填滿就宣告修復，卻未檢查已挫屈或疲勞的縱筋，下一次地震時牆端在原位置迅速破壞；修補時鑿除混凝土過深，切斷或損傷原有箍筋，反而降低圍束。

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「震後損傷判讀、修復與補強」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Post-earthquake damage interpretation, repair and strengthening" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 只以環氧樹脂灌注把裂縫填滿就宣告修復，卻未檢查已挫屈或疲勞的縱筋，下一次地震時牆端在原位置迅速破壞；修補時鑿除混凝土過深，切斷或損傷原有箍筋，反而降低圍束。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
剪力牆上鑽幾個管線孔不會影響結構安全，不需要結構工程師評估。
optionsEn: Declaring a wall repaired after merely filling cracks with epoxy, without checking for buckled or fatigued longitudinal bars, lets the wall end fail quickly at the same spot in the next earthquake.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.

quiz.explanationEn: Declaring a wall repaired after merely filling cracks with epoxy, without checking for buckled or fatigued longitudinal bars, lets the wall end fail quickly at the same spot in the next earthquake; breaking out too deep during repair cuts or damages existing hoops and reduces confinement. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 開孔變更管控、竣工紀錄與工程交接：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Controlling later openings, as-built records and handover: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「開孔變更與竣工圖」如何影響鋼筋混凝土剪力牆施工的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Later openings and as-built drawings” governs force, deformation or durability in “Reinforced-concrete shear-wall construction”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 剪力牆在使用期間最常遭遇的破壞來源不是地震，而是後來的開孔：機電管線、門洞、窗口或裝修改造。在剪力牆上鑽孔或切割，會減少剪力斷面、切斷縱筋或水平筋，甚至把一道長牆變成兩道短牆，改變整棟建築的側力分配。因此交接文件必須清楚標示哪些牆是剪力牆、邊界構材與塑性鉸區的位置，以及哪些範圍禁止開孔；任何開孔都要經結構工程師評估。施工期間的開孔變更也應同樣受控。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「開孔變更與竣工圖」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The commonest threat to shear walls in service is not earthquakes but later openings: services penetrations, doors, windows or fit-out changes. Drilling or cutting a shear wall reduces shear area, cuts vertical or horizontal bars and may turn one long wall into two short ones, changing the lateral force distribution of the whole building. Handover documents must therefore clearly identify which walls are shear walls, where boundary elements and plastic-hinge zones are, and which areas must not be penetrated, with every opening assessed by a structural engineer. Opening changes during construction need the same control. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Later openings and as-built drawings” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：ACI 318 牆剪力強度 V_n = A_cv(α_c√f′_c + ρ_t f_y)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: ACI 318 wall shear strength V_n = A_cv(α_c√f′_c + ρ_t f_y).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「剪力牆上鑽幾個管線孔不會影響結構安全，不需要結構工程師評估。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Drilling a few services holes in a shear wall does not affect structural safety and needs no structural engineer's assessment." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「開孔變更與竣工圖」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Later openings and as-built drawings”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 開孔變更管控、竣工紀錄與工程交接
knowledge.titleEn: Controlling later openings, as-built records and handover
knowledge.text: 剪力牆在使用期間最常遭遇的破壞來源不是地震，而是後來的開孔：機電管線、門洞、窗口或裝修改造。在剪力牆上鑽孔或切割，會減少剪力斷面、切斷縱筋或水平筋，甚至把一道長牆變成兩道短牆，改變整棟建築的側力分配。
knowledge.textEn: The commonest threat to shear walls in service is not earthquakes but later openings: services penetrations, doors, windows or fit-out changes. Drilling or cutting a shear wall reduces shear area, cuts vertical or horizontal bars and may turn one long wall into two short ones, changing the lateral force distribution of the whole building.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：剪力牆上鑽幾個管線孔不會影響結構安全，不需要結構工程師評估。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Drilling a few services holes in a shear wall does not affect structural safety and needs no structural engineer's assessment. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「開孔變更管控、竣工紀錄與工程交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Controlling later openings, as-built records and handover" is correct?
options: 剪力牆上鑽幾個管線孔不會影響結構安全，不需要結構工程師評估。
剪力牆在使用期間最常遭遇的破壞來源不是地震，而是後來的開孔：機電管線、門洞、窗口或裝修改造。
建築裡每一道牆都平均分擔地震力，所以多加幾道短牆就能有效提高抗震能力。
optionsEn: Drilling a few services holes in a shear wall does not affect structural safety and needs no structural engineer's assessment.

Every wall in a building shares seismic force equally, so adding a few short walls effectively raises seismic capacity.
quiz.explanation: 剪力牆在使用期間最常遭遇的破壞來源不是地震，而是後來的開孔：機電管線、門洞、窗口或裝修改造。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The commonest threat to shear walls in service is not earthquakes but later openings: services penetrations, doors, windows or fit-out changes. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 開孔變更管控、竣工紀錄與工程交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Controlling later openings, as-built records and handover: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「開孔變更與竣工圖」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Later openings and as-built drawings” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：ACI 318 牆剪力強度 V_n = A_cv(α_c√f′_c + ρ_t f_y)。牆長 8 m、厚 0.4 m，A_cv = 3.2×10⁶ mm²；α_c = 0.17、√42 ≈ 6.48、ρ_t = 0.0025、f_y = 420 MPa，單位應力 ≈ 1.10 + 1.05 = 2.15 MPa，V_n ≈ 6,886 kN。事後切出 1.2 m 寬開口時有效長度剩 6.8 m，V_n 降為約 5,853 kN（減少 15%），尚未計入被切斷鋼筋與開口角隅應力集中。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: ACI 318 wall shear strength V_n = A_cv(α_c√f′_c + ρ_t f_y). For an 8 m long, 0.4 m thick wall, A_cv = 3.2×10⁶ mm²; with α_c = 0.17, √42 ≈ 6.48, ρ_t = 0.0025 and f_y = 420 MPa, the unit stress is about 1.10 + 1.05 = 2.15 MPa and V_n ≈ 6,886 kN. Cutting a 1.2 m opening later leaves 6.8 m effective and V_n drops to about 5,853 kN, 15% less, before counting severed bars and stress concentrations at the corners. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：任何開孔申請須附開孔位置、尺寸與鋼筋掃描結果，由結構工程師以原設計模型評估並指定補強；施工時以鋼筋掃描避開主筋，完成後量測實際位置並更新竣工圖。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Every opening request should include location, size and a rebar scan, assessed by a structural engineer against the original design model with specified strengthening; during work use rebar scanning to avoid main bars, and survey the actual opening afterwards to update the as-built drawings.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: ACI 318 牆剪力強度 V_n = A_cv(α_c√f′_c + ρ_t f_y)。牆長 8 m、厚 0.4 m，A_cv = 3.2×10⁶ mm²；α_c = 0.17、√42 ≈ 6.48、ρ_t = 0.0025、f_y = 420 MPa，單位應力 ≈ 1.10 + 1.05 = 2.15 MPa，V_n ≈ 6,886 kN。事後切出 1.2 m 寬開口時有效長度剩 6.8 m，V_n 降為約 5,853 kN（減少 15%），尚未計入被切斷鋼筋與開口角隅應力集中。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: ACI 318 wall shear strength V_n = A_cv(α_c√f′_c + ρ_t f_y). For an 8 m long, 0.4 m thick wall, A_cv = 3.2×10⁶ mm²; with α_c = 0.17, √42 ≈ 6.48, ρ_t = 0.0025 and f_y = 420 MPa, the unit stress is about 1.10 + 1.05 = 2.15 MPa and V_n ≈ 6,886 kN. Cutting a 1.2 m opening later leaves 6.8 m effective and V_n drops to about 5,853 kN, 15% less, before counting severed bars and stress concentrations at the corners. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

鋼筋放得越多越密，剪力牆就越安全。

optionsEn: As long as the total hoop steel meets the calculation, whether hooks are 90° or 135° does not matter.
The more and the denser the reinforcement, the safer the shear wall.
ACI 318 wall shear strength V_n = A_cv(α_c√f′_c + ρ_t f_y).

steps.title: 開孔變更管控、竣工紀錄與工程交接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Controlling later openings, as-built records and handover: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「開孔變更與竣工圖」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Later openings and as-built drawings” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 任何開孔申請須附開孔位置、尺寸與鋼筋掃描結果，由結構工程師以原設計模型評估並指定補強；施工時以鋼筋掃描避開主筋，完成後量測實際位置並更新竣工圖。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Every opening request should include location, size and a rebar scan, assessed by a structural engineer against the original design model with specified strengthening; during work use rebar scanning to avoid main bars, and survey the actual opening afterwards to update the as-built drawings. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時提供以顏色標示剪力牆、邊界構材與禁止開孔區的平面圖，並將其納入建築物使用維護手冊；管理單位應建立開孔申請與審查程序，所有開孔都要記錄在竣工圖的更新版本中。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover provide colour-coded plans showing shear walls, boundary elements and no-penetration zones and include them in the building's operation and maintenance manual; the owner should run an opening application and review procedure, recording every opening in updated as-built drawings.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：裝修工程未查閱竣工圖就在一樓剪力牆切出大門洞，正好切掉邊界構材，牆的撓曲與剪力能力都大幅下降，平時看不出異狀，直到地震才暴露；機電管線密集鑽孔使牆體形成一排弱點，地震中沿孔洞連線開裂。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A fit-out contractor who never checked the as-built drawings cuts a large doorway through a ground-floor shear wall, removing a boundary element, so the wall loses much of its flexural and shear capacity with no visible sign until an earthquake; dense services holes drilled in a line create a row of weak points along which the wall cracks in an earthquake. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 開孔變更管控、竣工紀錄與工程交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Controlling later openings, as-built records and handover: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「開孔變更與竣工圖」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Later openings and as-built drawings” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 裝修工程未查閱竣工圖就在一樓剪力牆切出大門洞，正好切掉邊界構材，牆的撓曲與剪力能力都大幅下降，平時看不出異狀，直到地震才暴露；機電管線密集鑽孔使牆體形成一排弱點，地震中沿孔洞連線開裂。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A fit-out contractor who never checked the as-built drawings cuts a large doorway through a ground-floor shear wall, removing a boundary element, so the wall loses much of its flexural and shear capacity with no visible sign until an earthquake; dense services holes drilled in a line create a row of weak points along which the wall cracks in an earthquake. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：施工期間的開孔變更也應同樣受控。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Opening changes during construction need the same control.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「剪力牆上鑽幾個管線孔不會影響結構安全，不需要結構工程師評估。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Drilling a few services holes in a shear wall does not affect structural safety and needs no structural engineer's assessment." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 裝修工程未查閱竣工圖就在一樓剪力牆切出大門洞，正好切掉邊界構材，牆的撓曲與剪力能力都大幅下降，平時看不出異狀，直到地震才暴露；機電管線密集鑽孔使牆體形成一排弱點，地震中沿孔洞連線開裂。
knowledge.textEn: A fit-out contractor who never checked the as-built drawings cuts a large doorway through a ground-floor shear wall, removing a boundary element, so the wall loses much of its flexural and shear capacity with no visible sign until an earthquake; dense services holes drilled in a line create a row of weak points along which the wall cracks in an earthquake.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「開孔變更管控、竣工紀錄與工程交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Controlling later openings, as-built records and handover" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
裝修工程未查閱竣工圖就在一樓剪力牆切出大門洞，正好切掉邊界構材，牆的撓曲與剪力能力都大幅下降，平時看不出異狀，直到地震才暴露。
建築裡每一道牆都平均分擔地震力，所以多加幾道短牆就能有效提高抗震能力。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.

A fit-out contractor who never checked the as-built drawings cuts a large doorway through a ground-floor shear wall, removing a boundary element, so the wall loses much of its flexural and shear capacity with no visible sign until an earthquake.
Every wall in a building shares seismic force equally, so adding a few short walls effectively raises seismic capacity.

quiz.explanationEn: A fit-out contractor who never checked the as-built drawings cuts a large doorway through a ground-floor shear wall, removing a boundary element, so the wall loses much of its flexural and shear capacity with no visible sign until an earthquake; dense services holes drilled in a line create a row of weak points along which the wall cracks in an earthquake.
